roles.low_order_split_hash: position-block split: positions sorted by sha256('gfp-position-v1:' + integer position), first ceil(30%) observed positions => dev and remainder => train; low-order variants are assigned only if all mutated positions share one role, cross-role records are excluded; targets approximately 70/30 positions, not rows

models.selection: minimum mean dev MAE across all five seeds; ties >1e-12 broken by higher mean dev Spearman, then smaller channels, then smaller kernel
models.early_stopping: best training-standardized dev MAE, minimum delta 1e-6
models.ensemble: unweighted arithmetic mean of five seed predictions in original DMS_score units

evaluation.regret: pool maximum measured DMS_score minus maximum measured DMS_score among selected candidates
evaluation.primary_difference: BoN regret minus mean RandomN regret; negative favors BoN
evaluation.tie_break: proxy score descending then variant_id ascending; oracle maximum and ties use all measured labels without arbitrary oracle selection
metrics: top-tail hits and lift over RandomN

stop_conditions: source hash, row count, sequence or label validation fails
fewer than 16 disjoint test pools of size 1000
CUDA unavailable or no observed CUDA training allocation
test labels accessed before all test predictions and code/config hashes are frozen
